'''Psychology''' is a [[skill]]. It first appeared in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
When you make any [[Will check]], add +1 to each die you roll for purposes of checking for successes (i.e., a roll of 3 become a 4, etc.).
